params.name: prefix
params.reason: Restricts results to bucket names with this prefix.

params.name: projection
params.reason: Controls which properties each bucket includes.

params.name: returnPartialSuccess
params.reason: Adds names of buckets in unreachable locations to the response.

params.name: softDeleted
params.reason: Limits results to soft-deleted bucket versions when true.

params.name: userProject
params.reason: Specifies the project billed for the request.

reason: Classifications follow each parameter’s stated effect on the returned buckets, response contents, or request billing.
